title: 🔊 Text to Speech Web App | HTML, CSS & JavaScript
description:
🔊 Text to Speech Web App | HTML, CSS & JavaScript

This project is a modern Text-to-Speech web application built using pure HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript, powered by the Web Speech API.

The app allows users to convert any written text into natural-sounding speech, with full control over:

  • 🎙️ Voice selection

  • ⚡ Speech rate

  • 🎵 Pitch

  • 🔊 Volume

  • ⏸ Pause / Resume

  • ⏹ Stop speech anytime

The UI is designed with a glass-style card, smooth animations, responsive layout, and clear user feedback through a dynamic status system.

This project is perfect for:

  • Accessibility tools ♿

  • Learning browser APIs

  • Front-end practice

  • Content creators & educational demos

✨ Fully responsive, user-friendly, and beginner-to-advanced friendly.

Tech used:
HTML • CSS • JavaScript • Web Speech API

📌 No libraries. No frameworks. Just clean front-end logic.
